site.site_alignment: Uniform registration of the unobscured user site plan to four main-house corners; see site-registration.json. Supersedes the TPO outline/alignment.
site.area_reference_note: User confirms the whole site is about 0.3 acres. Model is about 0.308 acres; retain plan shape rather than force a fit to a rounded area.
site.gate_return_basis: Owner confirms entrance widens towards road; outer connections splayed650mm each along frontage, amount estimated. Inner annotated gatepost positions retained.
site.gate_position_basis: Blue gate span and red fountain centre in user annotated aerial, registered to clear site-plan boundary. See annotated-aerial-registration.json.
site.boundary_material_basis: Owner confirmed right/east divide is greenery/trees without brick wall; fences around rear extension behind neighbours are timber. Main rear niche wall retained from photos. Fence height/panel design estimated.
site.limitations: Title plan shows general boundaries; map scale, house alignment, wall heights, planting, fountain sizes and gate positions are inferred. TPO symbols are not a surveyed tree inventory.

rear_dormer.floor_structure: New loft floor over existing rooms and side wing; support design is not inferred from the model

specification.name: Ashley Heights — additive proposal

entranceBay.basis: Owner: entrance gable protrudes further with rendered walls and piers, a rake band as wide as the piers, no roof overhang, and the glazing inset 500 mm, after the front inspiration image; owner (P8 review): the roof stays at the wing eaves (a raised trial looked too tall); above the door-head transom the glazing is trapezoid panes rising to the rake, and the fascia band under the new roofs is as deep as the walls; owner: the rake band is exactly the roof package deep (0.35 m, measured square to the rake), the upper glazing frame sits 120 mm below the soffit behind a white head packer so it shows from outside, and every frame member in the entrance is 55 mm

garageBay.upper_space: Vaulted window alcove open to the principal suite through the full gable section at floor level; the gable window lights it. Headroom is 2.15 m under the ridge only, so the low sides of the vault are kept off the walking route.
garageBay.basis: Owner: the double garage becomes a lower 1.5-storey wing across the whole south end of the front wing, projecting forward under a wide 30° gable with a window in it, after the front inspiration image

forecourt.planters: raised rendered planters with clipped box and olive trees flanking the entrance
forecourt.basis: Owner: make the forecourt look like the front inspiration image

frontage.basis: Owner: replace the brick piers, plinths and iron railings with a straight boundary wall and a sliding gate flat in the wall line

specification.fountain: remove entire fountain and planted island
specification.frontWingBasis: P5 keeps the P4 main-wing footprint but replaces the east attached anteroom with an open internal garden, reducing the comparison enclosed ground-floor area; original168.134m² target is retained for comparison only and is no longer matched.
specification.structuralChanges: P6 proposal: remove the old central front door, porch, arched landing window and local front wall for the attached entrance; retain the drawing-room bay beside an open garden. Convert the original garage/utility footprint to two storeys, remove its garage door, flat roof and utility partitions, and open its rear into garden living. Repurpose Bedroom5 as the side-wing connecting landing with local door/window openings while retaining the through-floor lift. Add an underground wine cellar and dedicated dogleg access below the former garage. Retain the original house stair and stacked loft stair; remove the separate new-front-wing stair. Other changes are documented in proposal-only copies; the separate original model remains unchanged. P6 also removes the kitchen rear-window sill and glazing below its retained lintel for direct garden dining access, with new kitchen fittings. New lightweight partitions form the shared side shower room, front-wing gym and upstairs laundry.

newWingRoof.basis: Owner: extension about 10% smaller; east wall in 0.5 m, eaves to the original 5.35 m, ridge 8.7 m

frontCentralDemolition.scope: Remove original front door, porch, arched landing window and central front wall; direct continuous entrance/landing connection
frontCentralDemolition.preserved: Existing remaining room walls, stair and floor positions

specification.roofBrief: Conventional pitched new wing and central connector with continuous trimmed valleys to original roof. No flat loft bridge; the owner added a flat east dormer over the new-wing loft studio (P8 review). Original rear dormer/pool pavilion/garden living roof remain separate reference-led elements.

internalGarden.basis: P5 owner request: open-to-sky garden immediately outside the retained original drawing-room bay. Complete bay window, masonry, roof and curtains retained. Former east anteroom no longer enclosed floor area.
internalGarden.bayClearanceReason: Straight X10.35 glazing would cut the original western angled bay pane; returned boundary clears its shallow roof by approximately65mm and masonry by more.

enclosedAreaComparison.basis: Same230mm inward-offset isolated envelope comparison as P3; conservative fixed allowance for new glazed boundary, not measured net habitable floor area. Main wing and parking unchanged.

internalGarden.glazingBasis: Owner: the gallery glazing runs straight at x 9.7 instead of returning round the bay; the first floor above is unchanged

specification.areaTargetStatus: Superseded by user-directed internal garden; do not enlarge wing or parking footprint to force equal area.
specification.refinementBrief: Remove secondary dining-bay glass vestibule; former garage becomes open garden living, gym relocated into front wing; continue new-wing roof into original roof; remove orphan rear utility window frames; unify side-wing facade finishes.
specification.bedroomBrief: Six main bedrooms. Repurpose garden-facing north side-wing bedroom as a shared upstairs family lounge with fitted storage and a window-side work table. Preserve all four remaining original bedrooms, the new front principal suite and the south side bedroom.

entertainmentBasement.basis: New northern half of front wing; original wine cellar remains separate. New stair replaces only the ground-floor reading alcove, retaining the entrance/gallery route, gym and garage parking.

specification.frontWingUpperBasis: Owner: the ground floor and garage stay as they are; the first floor and loft come 0.5 m in from the east under a lower roof

wingDormer.basis: Owner: a second flat-roofed dormer on the east slope of the new wing gives the loft studio standing headroom beyond the 2.4 m ridge band. It starts where the east slope soffit meets its 8.12 m ceiling (x 9.51), stops at the studio partition, and its south cheek sits inside the ridge run north of the south hip start (y -16.0).

specification.pavilionBasis: Owner: the glazed pavilion runs the full length of the existing outbuilding row, back to the north end of the outside WC brickwork, and projects 2.22 m (was 2.82 m) in front of it. The tool store and WC doors now open into it.

hotTub.pavilion_route: The unchanged east pool aisle X10.16..11.30 remains fully clear; route centreX10.80 continues north to pavilion.
hotTub.navigation: External stairs are walkable; the filled tub interior is a fixed obstacle.

terraceWalkOnLanterns.basis: Owner: three flush walk-on glass roof lanterns in the terrace over the glazed rear extension, in a row deep in the room clear of the door sweeps and the cafe group.

loftProgramme.floor_structure: New loft floor over existing rooms and side wing; support design is not inferred from the model

chimney.stack: Original chimney unchanged; boxed below the roof lining within the eaves storage zone
chimney.allowance: Flue clearance to the new dormer cheek and lining remains a specialist check

sideWing.roof_basis: Original front/rear slopes extended west; original ridge height preserved. Roof module owns envelope and profiled wall closures.
sideWing.programme: Side garden living occupies the ground floor; front-east stair descends to an underground wine cellar. One bedroom, a shared family lounge/storage room and a shower room connect through former Bedroom5.
sideWing.wine_room_basis: Owner selected underground cellar beneath the former garage footprint; new dedicated dogleg access.

sharedBathroom.privacy_window: Existing side-west middle window at Y4.4; original aperture retained
sharedBathroom.basis: Reuse west hall dead end and a shallow strip of south bedroom; retain the bedroom and lounge doors and the lift route.

entertainment_basement.basis: New northern half of front wing; original wine cellar remains separate. New stair replaces only the ground-floor reading alcove, retaining the entrance/gallery route, gym and garage parking.
entertainment_basement.technical_basis: Concept allowance for a new retaining shell, waterproofing, ventilation and supporting the ground-floor slab; detailed structure, ground conditions and escape design remain to be resolved.
